in_hebrew.name: Romano
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Roman, from Rome
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Romano הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word 'Romanus', meaning a 'citizen of Rome'. This name has been popular among Christians due to its biblical reference to the Roman centurion who had faith and humility.

in_greek.name: Romano
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Roman, from Rome
in_greek.long_meaning: Romano είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Latin word 'Romanus', meaning a 'citizen of Rome'. This name has been popular among Christians due to its biblical reference to the Roman centurion who had faith and humility.
